# ezghcloud_cache (Data Source)

Read an existing EZGH Cloud cache by its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Cache ID (cch_).
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_source_cidrs` (List of String) 1 to 20 IPv4 CIDRs allowed to connect. Left out, the VPC's ranges.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) While true, the cache can't be destroyed.
- `description` (String) Optional description; null clears it.
- `endpoint_hostname` (String) The endpoint's DNS name; null until it resolves. It stays the same through failovers and upgrades.
- `endpoint_plaintext_port` (Number) Memcached's port without TLS, 11212, while plaintext_port is true; null otherwise.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) The endpoint's TLS port: 6379 on Valkey, 11211 on Memcached.
- `engine` (String) valkey or memcached. Changing it replaces the cache.
- `engine_version` (String) Engine version: Valkey 8.1 or 9.1, Memcached 1.6. A newer version upgrades in place (one-way); an older one is refused at plan. On Memcached an upgrade is applied in the maintenance window and the cache starts empty.
- `instance_type` (String) A gp-1 or gs-1 instance type. Changes in place.
- `maintenance_window_utc` (String) Weekly maintenance window, ddd:HH:MM-ddd:HH:MM UTC, at least 30 minutes.
- `mode` (String) memory or persistent (Valkey only, with storage_size_gib). Changing it replaces the cache.
- `name` (String) Cache name. Changes in place.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `parameters` (Map of String) Engine parameters, such as maxmemory-policy. Only configured keys are sent and read back; removing a key leaves its value as it is.
- `plaintext_port` (Boolean) Memcached only: also serve port 11212 without TLS, with a username and password (true unless set). Null on Valkey, which is TLS only. Changes in place.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `standby` (Boolean) A standby that takes over if the cache fails: on Valkey with a live copy of the data, on Memcached empty. Changes in place.
- `status` (String) What the cache is doing.
- `storage_iops` (Number) A persistent cache's provisioned storage IOPS. Changes in place.
- `storage_size_gib` (Number) A persistent cache's storage in GiB, required for one and refused otherwise. Grows in place; shrinking is refused.
- `storage_throughput_mbps` (Number) A persistent cache's provisioned storage throughput in MB/s. Changes in place.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet (sbn_) the cache is in: it needs 2 free addresses, 3 with a standby. Changing it replaces the cache.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC of the subnet.
